config.stage: Task19 originale, Atto III: gate singolo
config.fit_sampling: 50% uniform[-135,75],25%[-120,-95] Ih region,25%[-45,-25] Im region. Both channels/objectives receive identical tuples.

hypotheses.single_gate_transfer: The constrained one-state cell learns Ih and Im independently and passes all registered in-support gates in all three seeds.
hypotheses.rate_identifiability: Rate supervision reduces inf/logtau error and long held-voltage rollout error relative to transition-only training on paired streams.
hypotheses.capacity_budget: Two widths and checkpoints distinguish capacity from optimization; extra capacity or steps need not improve every metric monotonically.
hypotheses.state_rollout: State-extrema probes and 1000 repeated 1ms held-voltage updates reveal errors hidden by average one-step metrics.
hypotheses.numerical_reference: LUT513/2049 match authentic single-gate dynamics in support, providing an accuracy/compute reference.

config.selection: For each channel/objective choose one common width/checkpoint across3seeds by worst-seed worst-domain normalized sum of gateRMSE,gateMAX,infRMSE,logtauRMSE on development uniform/tail/state_extrema. Freeze all selections/hashes before fresh generation. Same selection rule for both objectives. Rollout does not select models.
config.promotion: Task20 authorized only if selected rate-supervised models for both channels and all3seeds pass fresh in_support,negative_tail,state_extrema and every registered rollout horizon. Negative and positive voltage OOD are diagnostic; never pooled into promotion.
config.native_contract: Canonical teacher074c466; Ih vshift=0,vhalf=-154.9,ehcn=-45; Im fixed qt=2.3^1.3,ek=-85 for diagnostic current. Exact Ih v==vhalf perturbs local rate voltage by+0.0001 in canonical MOD; observed section voltage remains clamped: preserve and report separately; no silent smoothing. RANGE-only instrumentation. Native rates/one-step errors<1e-7, unexpected section-voltage drift<1e-8mV.
config.architecture: MLP1->width->width->2 with SiLU; inf=sigmoid, tau=exp(clamped logtau); xnext=(1-z)x+z*inf; z=-expm1(-dt/tau). Independent weights per channel/objective/seed; objectives have paired identical initialization. Physical current=gbar*x*(V-E),gbar=1e-5S/cm2.
config.limits: Isolated constant voltage, fixed canonical temperature/shift; no varying voltage sufficiency, embedding, shared weights(Task22), or full-neuron speedup claimed. Open fraction equals x for both channels. OOD Ih singularity remains canonical diagnostic.
config.performance: Eager CUDA forward timings at batch4096 for selected single-model seed17, Torch analytic formula and LUT2049. CUDA events,warmup10,100repeats,accuracy reported alongside; no NEURON or end-to-end speedup inference.
